fidelity: F2a — Three-Zone Lumped Energy Balance (UCZ/NCZ/LCZ) with Beer-Lambert Attenuation
source: Tabor (1981) Solar ponds, Solar Energy 27(3):181-194; Hull (1980) Computer simulation of solar pond thermal behavior, Solar Energy 25:33-40; Rabl & Nielsen (1975) Solar ponds for space heating, Solar Energy 17:1-12; Wang & Akbarzadeh (1982) A parametric study on solar ponds, Solar Energy 30(6):555-562; Duffie & Beckman (2013) Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes, ch.9.

unit.name: Non-Convecting Salt-Gradient Solar Pond — Three Zone Lumped

A_pond.note: Pond surface area (1 ha demonstration pond, e.g. Beit Ha'Arava / El Paso)

h_ucz.note: Upper Convective Zone (surface mixed layer) thickness

h_ncz.note: Non-Convecting (gradient/insulating) Zone thickness — Tabor recommends ~1-1.5 m

rho_brine.note: Density of hot concentrated NaCl brine in LCZ (~20-26% w/w)

cp_brine.note: Specific heat of concentrated brine (lower than water due to salinity)

k_water.note: Thermal conductivity of saline water in NCZ (conductive insulation path)

tau_surface.note: Fraction of incident radiation transmitted through the air-water surface (after reflection)

mu_extinction.note: Effective Bouguer/Beer-Lambert bulk extinction coefficient for brine (turbidity-dependent; Hull 1980, Rabl-Nielsen)

k_ground.note: Thermal conductivity of soil beneath pond

L_ground.note: Characteristic distance to constant-temperature ground sink

U_top.note: Effective top loss coefficient UCZ->ambient (convection+evaporation+radiation lumped)
